sources.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 35, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - AMER', lists for the metro Dallas eight IBX data centers: Stabilized DA1, DA2, DA3, DA4, DA6, DA7 and DA9; Expansion DA11; Owned DA1, DA2, DA3, DA6, DA9 and DA11; Leased DA4 and DA7. For Chicago it lists six, including CH5 in the New column. The Americas change summary names only TR4 (Toronto) as a closed IBX and nothing in Dallas, Denver or Miami. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025, Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with an expected expansion of one or more additional phases (or a redevelopment, or a new phase opened on or after 1 January 2025), and New Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating on or after 1 January 2025. Slide 30 reports Q3 2026 cabinets billed and recurring revenues for the 193 stabilized, 52 expansion and 12 new IBX data centers (257 in all). The presentation thus states that DA1, DA2, DA3, DA6, DE2 and MI1 are operating Equinix IBX data centers in its owned portfolio for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. No address, capacity per IBX or opening date is given.
